post_title: Cyberpunk 2077 Costs You $2.31 an Hour. Worth It?
post_caption:
Cyberpunk 2077 is $59.99 on Steam and takes about 26 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): $2.31 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 109 hours) and it drops to 55 cents an hour. Our own math.
Is Cyberpunk 2077 worth $60 in 2026?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
Music: official trailer audio (Cyberpunk 2077 — Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition — City of Dreams) · CD PROJEKT RED

post_title: GTA 6 Is Out: Your Console Runs It at 30 FPS
post_caption:
GTA 6 is out, and Rockstar targets 30 frames per second on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S, with no 60 fps mode at launch. The PS5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows no other console gets: better looks, same frame rate.
Would you trade 30 fps for those visuals, or wait for a 60 fps patch?

post_caption:
